scope: Actual native Fountain suggestion authoring, normal GitLab submission and real single-suggestion repository application; excludes resolved Rapid Diffs gutter reopening, review batching and role/concurrency acceptance.
observations: Real selected multiline diff context inserts exact raw backslash-n and genuine U+E000 as distinct original source values.
Replacement plus expanded range apply and undo/redo atomically in the actual native menu.
Ctrl+Enter leaves source without triggering GitLab quick submit; subsequent prose remains in the draft.
Normal GitLab submission persists exact native suggestion source, offsets and prose via the authenticated discussions API.
GitLab Apply suggestion creates a real source-branch commit containing exactly the intended replacement and untouched remaining file lines.
readerRoute: MR overview note anchor after application; resolved Rapid Diffs gutter reopening remains a separate retained UI issue.
